title: Auth Admin
notes:
- Any method under the `supabase.auth.admin` namespace requires a `secret` key.
- These methods are considered admin methods and should be called on a trusted server. Never expose your `secret` key in the Flutter app.
- On a server, create the client from `package:supabase` with the `secret` key. A server has no user session to refresh or persist.

examples.name: Create server-side auth client
examples.code:
```dart
final supabase = SupabaseClient(
  'https://your-project.supabase.co',
  'your-secret-key',
  authOptions: const AuthClientOptions(autoRefreshToken: false),
);
```
